text:
Sasha: quick triage — after yesterday's routing tweak we see p95 jump in eu-west but p50 is fine. Suspect edge routing changes + a kernel/quant combo. Putting initial numbers and links below.

Mike: link pls, want to see heatmaps and single-pop traces.

Sasha: https://redwood.charts/r/edge-latency/171945 — summary: us-east p50=32ms p95=120ms, us-west p50=35ms p95=130ms, eu-west p50=40ms p95=360ms. throughput ~420 req/s cluster-wide.

Anya: are those for INT8-quant + flash-attn or FP16 + fused? Need the model config — quantization often blows up tail in small pops.

Sasha: current rollout used INT8 round2 + flash-attn fallback when memory pressure. Config snippet:```model="redwood-alpha-v2",quant="int8_round2",kernel_hint="flash_attn_v2",batch_limit=8,route_policy="edge-weighted"```

Sasha: raw metric query I ran:```promql: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))```

Leon: seeing a lot of long TCP connect times from eu-edge -> backend in the traces. Could be POP saturation or NAT gateway bursting. p95 jumps line up with connection retries.

Jamie: also noticed GC/pagemap churn on the eu-west hosts when INT8 fallback kicks in — that can add hundreds of ms when we touch the disk-backed KV cache.

Mike: let's compare kernels quickly — can we run a 5m microbenchmark on eu-west with fused-attn + fp16 and flash-attn + int8? Need p50/p95 and qps with same synthetic load. I'll spin it up.

infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: routing/edge-weighted v2 applied by ops at 2024-07-26T14:12:37Z (change-id: r-2345). Canary window active.

Sasha: plan: 1) revert edge-weighted routing weights to prior baseline (reduce eu-west weight by 40%) 2) run 10k synthetic requests from eu-edge -> eu-west with both kernel+quant combos 3) collect p50/p95, connection-level traces, and kernel-level time breakdown 4) create perf regression PR if change is repro.

Mike: I can run the microbench and push the reroute revert in 10m. Will post a small CSV of results.

Anya: if eu-west shows consistent higher p95 with INT8, we should block int8 rollout for that POP and add a fallback policy to prefer fp16 in small-pop routes.

Sasha: agreed. Owner: Mike for bench + revert. I'll create a short eval set to check quality drift if we switch quant per-pop.

Mike: ack. posting bench when done. :thumbsup:

Sasha: thanks — will follow up with quick postmortem and a KB entry on per-pop quant gating.
